target_customer: Fintechs, banks and apps that hold consumer deposits and want to offer investing
problem: Companies with consumer deposits wanted to offer managed investment accounts but lacked the brokerage, advisory and compliance setup to do it.
business_model: Usage and platform fees from an embedded investing API (advisory and brokerage)

founders.name: David Dindi
education: Stanford University, BSc and MSc in chemical engineering and computer science
founders.background_notes: From the YC page and a Nov 2021 Crowdfund Insider report.

founders.name: Marco Alban
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder and CTO by Crowdfund Insider, Nov 2021. YC page lists only Dindi.

competitors.name: DriveWealth
competitors.what: API based embedded brokerage for fintechs

competitors.name: Alpaca
competitors.what: Trading API for stocks and crypto for developers

technical_complexity.rationale: The API itself is standard, but operating as an SEC registered adviser and broker with a custodian (BNY Pershing) required regulatory build out beyond a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Licenses and custody relationships take time to replicate, and embedded customers are costly to switch.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found. Rivals kept operating independently through 2025.

market_need_then: Fintech and savings apps wanted to add investing in 2020, and retail investing demand had surged, per the company's pitch. No spend figures were found.

branding.domain_note: Uses atomicvest.com, not atomic.com, which suggests the exact domain was unavailable; not sourced.

identity.voice_and_tone: Reliable partner for banks, tagline The easy way to offer investing and savings

brand_strength.rationale: A B2B infrastructure brand with a generic name and no press about the brand found. Atomic Invest and AtomicVest are both used, a minor inconsistency.

outcome_analysis: Atomic raised a $25M Series A in November 2021 co-led by QED and Anthemis, launched its API from stealth, and later raised $30M in August 2025 and bought a Dutch investment firm in January 2026 to enter Europe. It remains active with about 25 staff. Its position rests on regulated licenses and custody ties, though traction numbers were not disclosed.
notes: Seed from SoftBank's $100M Opportunity Fund is mentioned by Crowdfund Insider with no amount or date, so no seed round is recorded. The $30M Aug 2025 round title appears on the YC page and the company news URL; stage and investors not seen. A $10M Feb 2026 raise appears in one tear sheet and is unverified. Competitors come from a Nov 2021 era profile and CB Insights, 15 months after the batch; DriveWealth was noted as founded 2012. Also acquired Groene Hart Financiele Diensten, Jan 2026. Name origin not found.
